title: Bangalore Technical Universities General Regulations on On-Duty (OD) Leave

clauses.heading: Eligibility for On-Duty (OD) Leave
clauses.text: A student maintaining a minimum cumulative class attendance of 75% prior to the event date is eligible to apply for up to three (3) consecutive working days of On-Duty (OD) leave per semester for recognized collegiate hackathons, technical conferences, or inter-university competitions.

clauses.heading: Mandatory Prior Written Permission
clauses.text: To claim OD attendance waiver, the student must submit an official permission letter signed by the Faculty Advisor and Head of Department (HoD) at least forty-eight (48) hours before the event commencement.

clauses.heading: Participation Verification Requirement
clauses.text: Upon returning, the student must produce a verified Certificate of Participation or verified Attendance Record issued by the organizing body within three (3) working days to confirm attendance credit.

title: Campus Intellectual Property & Hackathon Project Ownership Code

clauses.heading: Student Ownership of Hackathon Creations
clauses.text: All source code, software prototypes, designs, and intellectual property conceived and created solely by students during hackathons, workshops, or extracurricular events belong 100% to the student team members.

clauses.heading: Sponsor and Organizer License Restrictions
clauses.text: Event sponsors and host colleges may retain non-exclusive rights to showcase, demonstrate, and archive project submissions for evaluation and promotional purposes, but acquire no equity, proprietary license, or patent rights without explicit written student consent.

title: Inter-Collegiate Hackathon Code of Conduct & Ethics

clauses.heading: Pre-existing Work Disclosure
clauses.text: All projects submitted for judging must be developed during the designated hackathon hack period. Third-party open-source libraries and public foundation models (e.g., HuggingFace, Databricks DBRX, OpenAI APIs) are permitted provided they are disclosed in the project readme.

title: Student Travel Grant & Competitive Representation Reimbursement Policy

clauses.heading: Travel and Registration Grants
clauses.text: Teams selected for finals of national-level hackathons with prize pools exceeding INR 1,00,000 are eligible for up to 100% travel reimbursement (second sleeper train/bus fare) and entry fee waiver subject to Dean approval.
